EPR Category + Fee Estimator

Classify packaging components, estimate state EPR fee ranges, and audit the assumptions. Data embedded from the May 2026 v4 workbook.

Currency
Language

How to use this app

  1. Classify one packaging component at a time.
  2. For multi-material packaging, split parts that are normally separable.
  3. Add annual pounds for each component.
  4. Click Add to estimator.
  5. Review totals, assumptions, and the audit trail.

Use estimated states for planning only. Confirm published reporting categories before compliance use.
